subject: structural audit of the two cost-65f WIN7-D10 sweep receipts bits 20 and 21 of child 00000000000000809102000080000000 - the two receipts that closed the cost-64 manifest rows 00000000000000003800000008003000 and 00000000000000003800000008002002 in the cost-65j fold v2 (head-1410, remaining_covered_rows_at_1410 = 9)
method: independent TypeScript re-implementation (BigInt board, bit = y*11+x, D4 canonicalization over the 8 board transforms, integer-only det3/det4 concyclicity/collinearity arithmetic); no engine re-run, no network verdict sources; all inputs are the published receipts recompute record (class-frontier-cost65j-receipts-recompute-20261116.json), the remaining-worklist-1410 CSV, and the published fold v2 application audit (commit 72d18d2ca016f6c2224d9466ba3537172e936109)

sweep_candidate_convention.determined_rule: a legal S6->S7 sweep candidate (own_candidates / edge cost) is an empty cell c such that for EVERY triple (a,b,c) of the 6 stones, det4(a,b,c,c) != 0 - i.e. the placed stone completes no circle AND lies on no line through 3 existing stones (degenerate triples included); the sweep enumerates survival moves of the side to move, and edge cost = count of such cells
sweep_candidate_convention.arithmetic: det4(a,b,c,cell) = det3(a,b,c) - det3(a,b,cell) + det3(a,c,cell) - det3(b,c,cell), with det3 over rows [x^2+y^2, x, y]; exact integers, Number-safe
sweep_candidate_convention.evidence_17_receipts: all 17 fold-v2 receipt bits (4,15,18,20,21,23,25,28,66,79,91,101,109,112,116,118,119) are survival cells of the child under the inclusive rule
sweep_candidate_convention.evidence_worklist_cost_column: one representative row per cost stratum, 42 strata sampled from the 6,438-row remaining-worklist-1410 CSV: 42/42 match 115 - inclusive_completing_count

circle_only_variant_rejected.note: with degenerate (collinear) triples excluded, 9 of the 42 sampled rows mismatch, always with derived survival > published (completing undercounted); the inclusive rule fixes all 9

sweep_candidate_convention.practical_meaning: the entire own_candidates cost column of the 6,438-row worklist is independently re-derivable from the 6 stone positions alone with exact integer arithmetic; the column is a mobility lower bound for sweeps, not a game-theoretic quantity
